attempts.summary: Updated /srv/legacy2/posix-shell-installer/bin/install-report for POSIX sh. It now handles destinations containing spaces, preserves both templates and launcher content, makes the launcher executable, is repeatable, and returns a diagnostic plus nonzero status when installation cannot proceed. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 were retained.
